item: Calendar feed store: a store cut mid-character reads as empty and is logged instead of raising (R386, R397)
summary: _load_json caught OSError and JSONDecodeError but not UnicodeDecodeError (a ValueError), so a store cut in the middle of a multi-byte character (the stores are written with ensure_ascii=False, so titles like Noel with a diaeresis or Arabic holidays are multi-byte) made load_imports and merge_imported_store raise: the imported-events and feeds endpoints and a restore merge failed. It now reads as empty and logs the same class-only warning as any other unreadable store. The next save that can write still replaces the damaged store.
